[NDBG.10.1.3] Thread display names are taken from the rule's `RuleDebugName` atom
([RDSC.6.8.4]). The template `"alert_high(s={s.entity_id})"` is filled
with the firing's bound values, producing
names like `"alert_high(s=kitchen_temp)"`. When no `RuleDebugName` atom is present
the adapter falls back to `"{rule_name} !{N}"`, N being the firing's number as
[NDBG.9.3.5] writes it.
